verdict.rationale: CIPO runs account-based online services (MyCIPO, e-filing) that collect user-submitted data, so a data-use and AI-training privacy question is a fair one to ask of it. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training, data-use policies or opt-out controls. Its items cover only trademark, patent and design filing, search and bulk-data services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
